title: Rescue the canopy relay
story: Recovery phase one. Mica has one final delivery through a branching rail maze. Find any path to the canopy dock.
lesson: Breadth-first search explores adjacent cells with a queue. Store each candidate's path. Track visited coordinates so a cycle cannot trap the rover.
objective: Return legal moves from start to goal through each reachable grid. A zero-length trip returns [].
sample: Moves: UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT. grid[y][x] == '#' blocks a cell.
hint: Queue (position,path); for each valid unseen neighbor, append its direction to the path.
